mapper.insert: INSERT INTO term_suggestion (term, term_type, industry_code, usage_count, description, is_active) VALUES (#{term}, 'synonym', 'ecommerce', 5, #{description}, 1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE usage_count = usage_count + VALUES(usage_count)
mapper.select: SELECT table_name, table_comment FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = DATABASE() AND table_type = 'BASE TABLE'
SELECT column_name, data_type, column_comment FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = DATABASE() AND table_name = #{tableName} ORDER BY ordinal_position
